tools.name: track_product_link
tools.description: App-only analytics acknowledgement after requesting a product link to open. Never a product lookup or navigation tool.

tools.name: render_size_guide
tools.description: Render this connected store's size guide or size chart. Use for requests about sizing, measurements, clothing sizes, children's sizes, or footwear sizing. The result explains when the connected store does not provide the requested guide.

tools.name: render_complete_the_look
tools.description: Use this when a shopper wants Lorenzo products to pair, match, style or wear with a specific product. Render Complete the Look with store-configured complementary products and supplementary items. Examples: 'what can I pair with this?', 'what can I match?', 'suggest a suitable pair', 'suitable matching suggestions', 'recommend matching products', 'what goes well with it?', 'dress to pair with this product', or 'complete this outfit'. Follow-up pairing requests also need this tool when the subject is clear from current-store context; the shopper does not need to say 'Complete the Look' or 'call the tool'. Do not substitute a text-only styling answer for fetching store recommendations. For one subject product, call this tool exactly once. For multiple explicitly named subject products, call it at most once per subject. Do not call it automatically after an ordinary discovery search, and do not additionally open product search or product detail merely to prepare, validate, rank, compare, or explain these recommendations. Pass a known current-store product ID, otherwise the subject's exact title in query; this tool resolves it internally. Do not call product search first merely to resolve the subject. If 'this/it' is ambiguous or no subject is identified, ask which product rather than guessing. General shopping suggestions without a subject belong to render_product_search. If no matching products are configured, explain the returned limitation without inventing pairs or opening another UI.

product_id.description: Exact Shopify product GID of the subject to match, from a previous current-store result. Prefer this over query; never invent an ID or use a different store's ID.
product_id.title: Product Id

query.description: Subject product's exact current-store title, extracted from user wording or prior store context, when product_id is unknown. Example: 'Painter Tee - Black'. Do not pass the whole pairing question, 'this product', or the desired matching category.
query.title: Query

tools.name: product_details
tools.description: App-only normalized data lookup for one Lorenzo product.

tools.name: bootstrap_cart_session
tools.description: Create or validate the opaque cart session used by this app surface.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product variant to the current store cart and preserve existing items.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: Return the current Lorenzo cart contents to an already-rendered app.

tools.name: checkout_link
tools.description: Get the current continue/checkout URL for the store cart.

tools.name: begin_checkout
tools.description: Validate the current cart and return its checkout handoff URL.

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Replace the current store cart contents with the supplied full line item list.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Cancel and clear the current store cart completely.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove one cart item by line_id or variant_id from the current store cart.

tools.name: update_cart_item_quantity
tools.description: Set the quantity of one cart item by line_id or variant_id in the current store cart.

tools.name: replace_cart_item_variant
tools.description: Replace one cart item with another variant, such as switching size or color.

tools.name: render_product_search
tools.description: Search Lorenzo and render the interactive product carousel. Pass the shopper's product wording through in query without rewriting it. When the shopper states a budget, provide min_price and/or max_price in major currency units; use both with the same value only for an exact price. For one requested category or concept, call this tool exactly once and do not repeat or rephrase the search. If no products are returned, show the empty result and ask before trying a different query or relaxing constraints. For multiple explicitly requested categories, use one faithful combined search when possible; otherwise call this tool once per distinct category. Do not create separate searches for synonyms, colours, styles, audiences, or alternative wording. Use this for browsing or discovery, not as a preliminary lookup for an exact product-detail request. Do not automatically open product-detail tools for returned products to rank, compare, validate, or explain the results. For products to pair or match with a referenced item, use render_complete_the_look instead.

query.description: The shopper's product wording, passed to Shopify unchanged.
query.title: Query

min_price.description: Optional minimum price in major currency units.
min_price.title: Min Price

max_price.description: Optional maximum price in major currency units.
max_price.title: Max Price

tools.name: render_product_detail
tools.description: Render the interactive detail UI for one exact Lorenzo product. Pass a product_id when known; otherwise pass the exact product-name query directly because this tool resolves it internally. Use this only when the shopper explicitly asks to view, inspect, review, or get specifications for one exact product, or selects a product from search results. Do not call it automatically to rank, compare, validate, or explain discovery results. Do not call product search first to resolve the product. For matching items, recommended pairs or what to wear with this product, use render_complete_the_look instead.

tools.name: render_cart
tools.description: Always call this tool when the shopper asks to show, open, view, review, or check their cart. It renders the interactive cart UI; do not replace it with a text-only cart summary.

tools.name: render_action_confirmation
tools.description: Return a compact action confirmation contract for interactive rendering.
